headline.purpose: Sub-sheet titles and the verdict title.

title.purpose: The batch number on a result sheet — the largest ink on the page.

record.purpose: Anything read off a pack or returned by the register.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase legends above fields and particulars keys.

shadows.name: bench
shadows.purpose: The sheet at desk widths only — a page lying on a bench. The only shadow in the system; the content layer is flat.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen. A struck rectangle; hovers to oxide.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Everything that is not the one primary action. Inverts to carbon on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem; background: #ecebe1; color: #16150f; border: 1px solid #16150f; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 96%; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), color 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #16150f; color: #ecebe1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b0342a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A rule you write on, with its printed legend above. Never a box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; margin-bottom: 1.35rem; } .ds-field-legend { display: block; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 88%; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #676659; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.35rem 0.1rem; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #8b8a80; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Anonymous Pro', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.22rem; color: #16150f; transition: border-color 90ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #b0342a; }

components.name: Stamp — Flagged
components.description: The verdict, struck across the rule. Carries a drawn mark so the tier survives greyscale.
components.html: Not of standard quality
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; rotate: -4.5deg; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ecebe1, inset 0 0 0 3px currentColor; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 88%; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stamp-flagged { color: #b0342a; }

components.name: Nil mark — No entry on record
components.description: An absence is printed, never stamped. This is how the system refuses to say 'safe'.
components.html: No entry on record
components.css: .ds-nil { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 88%; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #494838; border-bottom: 1px solid #8b8a80; padding-bottom: 0.15rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Entry row
components.description: A medicine on its rule: numbered in the margin, batch in recorded type, verdict at the end.

components.description: The register's thumb-index tabs. Always labelled, never icon-only.

components.name: Particulars
components.description: Every claim pinned where it is made — alert month, lab, batch, source. Never behind a disclosure.

narrative.overview: Asli is not a health app that happens to cite a government list. It is the bench register a government drug-testing laboratory actually writes in, handed to a family. Every screen is a ruled sheet with an oxide-red double margin rule running its full height; every medicine is a numbered entry on a rule; every verdict is a rubber stamp struck across that rule. The density is generous rather than tight, because a register earns its authority from ruling and whitespace. Depth does not exist in the content layer: there are no shadows, only rules of varying weight. The system refuses the health-app card stack, the rounded status pill and above all the green tick, because a register has no vocabulary for 'safe' — it can only say what is on record and what is not. That constraint is the product's hardest safety rule, and here it is enforced by the medium rather than by anyone remembering it.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled, never carded — structure from horizontal rules and a vertical margin, not containers
Zero radius anywhere; zero content-layer shadow
Two Latin faces with jobs: Archivo prints the form, Anonymous Pro records the values
Six inks, locked; every other value is one of them at a stated proportion
Verdicts are struck, absences are printed — there is no stamp for 'nothing found'

rules.name: The Six Ink Rule
rules.body: There are six inks. Every other colour is one of them at a stated proportion via color-mix, never a value picked by eye. A new hex in this codebase is a bug.

rules.name: The Reserved Accent Rule
rules.body: Oxide red is the margin rule and the stamp. Never a highlight, a hover fill, or a background. When a red thing appears, the register has an entry.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: There is no green in this system and there will not be one. Green reads as approval, and Asli is never permitted to approve a medicine.

rules.name: The Chroma Lift Rule
rules.body: Dark-mode stamps lift in oklch toward white, not toward the stock; mixing a saturated ink into warm cream greys it out. Current ratios are the most saturated that still hold 4.5:1 on iron.

rules.name: The Printed / Recorded Rule
rules.body: If the form printed it, it is Archivo. If someone wrote it into the form, it is Anonymous Pro.

rules.name: The 18px Floor
rules.body: Base text is 18px, scaling to 22/26px. No tier-bearing word sits below 0.95rem. A verdict a 70-year-old cannot read is not a verdict.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the content layer casts a shadow. If a thing needs to feel separate, rule it.

dos: Do derive every new colour with color-mix from one of the six inks, and state the proportion.
Do give every screen exactly one primary button.
Do pin every claim where it is made: alert month, reporting lab, batch and source link live on the entry, never behind a disclosure.
Do print states into the record — one ruled line for loading, offline, error and empty.
Do keep Archivo for printed matter and Anonymous Pro for recorded values, and give Indic bands their own lang attribute.
Do number entries in the oxide margin; a bench register numbers its lines.
donts: Don't introduce a radius, a shadow in the content layer, a gradient, glass, or a pill.
Don't use oxide red for anything but the margin rule and the stamp.
Don't add green, a tick, or any word in the 'safe / genuine / verified' family — and don't invent a stamp for an absence.
Don't ship a toast, a snackbar, or a spinner; the only permitted overlay is the docket, for a genuinely focus-protecting task.
Don't set a tier-bearing word below 0.95rem, or let any tap target fall under 48px.
Don't let colour alone carry a tier; the drawn mark and the words ride with it always.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons. Icons are authored SVG at 1.75px, square caps.
